clauses.reason: Writing listings: selected contact-number, mailing-address, email and website-URL exclusion for supplied listing text; images are not inspected.

Writing listings: external ordering links and advertising inform the demo adaptation. It conservatively excludes all instructions to order or pay outside Amazon, even without a URL; this is an interpretation, not a verbatim source rule.

Writing listings: selected clear-description requirement only. Restricting the positive rule to physical products with features/specifications is demo scope, not a source ban on other product types; truth and completeness are not established.
Writing listings: style guides, category templates, code restrictions and the special line-break exception are omitted.

Writing listings: offensive material, availability/price/condition, alternative shipping offers, spoilers, reviews/testimonials and review requests, promotions, time-sensitive details, generic-brand content and restricted phrases are omitted.
Writing listings: title/highlight length, media exceptions, capitalization, emojis and symbols require separate field-aware checks.
Writing listings: accurate category and category restrictions require product/category evidence and linked rules.
Writing listings: trustworthy information and permissible product claims need truth/evidence and linked-policy review; a clear description is insufficient.
Writing listings: image standards and category image guidance cannot be checked from input.text.
Writing listings: essential additional items require product-function and completeness facts.
Adding detail pages: third-party intellectual-property rights require rights evidence and the linked policy.
Adding/editing detail pages: true identifiers, authorized GS1 GTINs and GTIN exemptions require external evidence.
General/adding/editing detail pages: duplicate pages, valid variations and separate ASINs for new versions require catalog/history facts and ASIN rules.
Adding detail pages: cross-merchandising and media bundle/single-product identifier restrictions are not selected.
Editing detail pages: original-product edits, repeated evasion, rebranding, generic/branded ASIN use and permitted minor corrections require history, identity and linked rules.
Brand Registry guidance: roles, competing contributions, administrator authority and support/abuse processes require account evidence; the text screen does not determine them.

limitations: Two selected English listing-text checks only, not full Amazon policy compliance or an official/endorsed policy.
Positive permission is deliberately limited to physical product descriptions; default review does not imply a source prohibition.
A2 conservatively adapts outside ordering/payment instructions, including instructions without links.
Quoted contact details and URLs remain literal selected-rule violations; no quotation or same-platform URL exception is invented.
An allow can coexist with an omitted source violation, including price details; see price-outside-selected-scope.
No image, account, product truth, category, catalog-history, ownership, linked-page or delivery verification.
Browser DOM observation has no linked HTTP response and does not qualify automated source retrieval, freshness or service eligibility.
Fixture evidence is synthetic and establishes binding/outcome reduction only, not semantic classification; no new live semantic evaluation is qualified.
